column1: # b06 D3 round 1: save menu, text, input/Pak, overlays, cutscenes

column3: Sets the save-menu state flags, selection, fade value, and navigation counters to initial values.
Advances the menu state and dispatches the slot list, dialog, load, save, delete, repair, or delay handler.
Draws the rectangular panel and selects its message from the current operation index.
Initializes or repairs the selected Pak, scans game files, and selects the error or file-list state.
Draws the selected message and optional two-choice prompt, then processes button and stick input to change menu state.
Renders up to two file-slot summaries and selection arrows, then handles stick navigation and confirmation.
Decrements the menu delay counter and returns to state zero when it expires.
Calls the Pak file-delete routine for the selected slot and chooses success or error message state.
Reads the selected Pak file into save buffers and restores game state on success.
Allocates a Pak file when the slot is empty, captures game state, writes both save blocks, and sets a result message.
Calls the Pak repair routine for the selected file error and updates success or failure state.
Rebuilds the file-slot list from scanned Pak entries and reads each game save header.
Appends the text display list, enables RGBA16 texture LUT, and clears the menu draw-state flag.
Draws the fixed menu background frame and divider rectangles.
Copies current player, map, inventory, and related globals into the selected save record and auxiliary buffer.
Copies the selected save record and auxiliary buffer back into player, map, inventory, and related globals.
Calls the window-reset routine for each of the four window slots.
Clears one window's flags, text buffers, choice rows, cursor, and animation state.
Finds a free window, copies name/message/choice data, assigns geometry and display flags, and returns its slot.
Orders four windows, advances opening/closing and message/choice states, reads input, and emits their graphics.
Draws a centered window at the current size step, increments the step, and reports completion.
Draws a window's name, prepared message buffer, and optional title texture.
Draws a filled rectangle, shadow edges, and bright border for one text window.
Copies encoded text into the visible buffer by row width and line count, handling page and end markers.
Animates and draws the small bottom-right marker for a waiting text window.
Sets choice-window dimensions from the number of rows and longest visible row.
Returns the window slot matching a requested type or stack-order value, or -1.
Loads a texture and palette by type and emits a textured rectangle at the requested bounds.
Draws a filled rectangle with shadow and border through the textured-rectangle helper.
Zeros the analog-stick hold counter used by the text-window update.
Returns true after the enabled stick input exceeds its magnitude threshold for five frames.
Copies bytes until the 0xFF terminator and writes the terminator to the destination.
DMAs the font palette and glyph data from ROM to their rendering buffers.
Parses 0xFF-terminated glyph and control bytes and emits textured glyph rectangles at X/Y.
Creates the SI message queue, initializes four controllers, chooses the first usable port, and returns connection state.
Reads the chosen controller and updates buttons, stick axes, and newly pressed button bits.
Initializes a selected Pak, enumerates its 16 files, identifies matching game files, and records free blocks.
Calls osPfsAllocateFile for the game's company/code/name and records the returned file number.
Calls osPfsDeleteFile using the game's company/code/name and selected extension byte.
Calls osPfsReadWriteFile in read mode for the selected Pak, file, offset, and byte count.
Checks free blocks and calls osPfsReadWriteFile in write mode for the selected file.
On Pak error 10 attempts reinitialization and osPfsRepairId, otherwise rechecks the file system.
Maps raw Pak error codes to six negative categories used by the save-menu state machine.
Compares two byte strings for the requested length; Pak_ScanGameFiles uses it on game_name.
Forwards the message queue to osContStartQuery.
Forwards a status buffer to osContGetQuery.
DMAs the title overlay ROM span beginning at D_DAB5F0 into the shared overlay address.
DMAs the intro overlay ROM span beginning at D_DC62B0 into the shared overlay address.
DMAs the ending overlay ROM span beginning at D_E22690 into the shared overlay address.
Zeros the scene sequence index and initializes its frame counter.
Advances to the next scene entry, loads its map/player/camera, and resets visual cue slots.
Applies the current camera frame and triggers the end transition near the scene's final frame.
Sets continuation or exit flags according to whether the scene index has reached the last entry.
Samples a camera track at the requested frame and writes camera position and orientation.
Starts frame-indexed image cues, draws each active textured rectangle with fade alpha, and advances cue timers.
Loads an entry's map, player, NPCs, camera, and message-sequence pointers.
Advances timed message/name pairs and reports when the sequence has finished.
Starts a 64-frame audio fade when the current entry's audio marker differs from the previous entry's.
Copies one message and one speaker-name buffer into the shared text-window globals.
